summary: Backend regression after server.py monolith → modular refactor: ran full pre-existing pytest suite (136 tests) against the live preview URL. 134/136 PASSED. Both failures are in the SAME route module — routes/chat.py — due to a missed import during the refactor: GET /api/chat/messages calls require_store_access(...) but routes/chat.py only imports get_current_user and decode_token from core.deps. NameError → 500. All other route modules (auth, stores, users, checklists, accounting v3, inventory phase 3/5, shopping-list both-PPT, submit-stock ceiling, shopped records) are byte-for-byte intact: 0 regressions in them. WebSocket endpoint not exercised by suite but the require_store_access import gap does NOT affect /ws/chat (it inlines the store-access check at lines 76-80), so live chat send/receive should still work — only the history endpoint is broken.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error — NameError: name 'require_store_access' is not defined. Refactor missed adding require_store_access to the core.deps import in routes/chat.py:10. Fix: change `from core.deps import get_current_user, decode_token` → `from core.deps import get_current_user, decode_token, require_store_access`. Affects routes/chat.py line 33. Reproduced via backend_test.py::TestChatHistory::test_history_returns_list and ::test_history_employee_blocked_from_other_store.

action_items: routes/chat.py: add require_store_access to the import line from core.deps (one-line fix). After fix, re-run only backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestChatHistory to confirm green.
Optional hardening: add a quick smoke for GET /api/chat/messages in CI so this class of refactor-miss is caught immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor quality is otherwise very clean — module boundaries (auth/stores/checklists/accounting/inventory/chat) match the request and 134 pre-existing tests pass unchanged.
routes/chat.py:9-10 — only get_current_user + decode_token are pulled in; require_store_access is used (line 33) but never imported. Static check (grep / ruff F821) would have caught this.

routes/chat.py WebSocket handler duplicates the store-access logic inline (lines 76-80) instead of reusing require_store_access — minor DRY note, not a bug, and it's why WS still works while HTTP history doesn't.
All routes correctly use APIRouter and are mounted with /api prefix; WS path /api/ws/chat is preserved as promised.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: during the server.py split, the chat HTTP history handler was moved into routes/chat.py but the import list in core.deps was narrowed to only get_current_user and decode_token. require_store_access (used on line 33 of routes/chat.py) was left out. At request time Python raises NameError → FastAPI returns 500. Reproduction: GET /api/chat/messages?store_id=<any> with a valid admin Bearer token → 500. Mitigation: add `require_store_access` to the existing `from core.deps import ...` line in routes/chat.py. No data migration or other module changes required.
